task1.title: Task 1: Letter/Email
task1.instructions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 120 words.
task1.prompt: You recently moved to a new city and want to join a local sports club. Write a letter to the club manager. In your letter: - introduce yourself - explain why you want to join - ask about membership fees and schedule

band_descriptors.task_achievement: All parts of the task are addressed. Tone is appropriate.
band_descriptors.coherence: Ideas are logically organized with clear paragraphs.
band_descriptors.lexical_resource: Good range of vocabulary for the topic.
band_descriptors.grammar: Generally accurate with some attempts at complex structures.

task2.title: Task 2: Essay
task2.instructions: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
task2.prompt: Some people believe that university education should be free for everyone. Others argue that students should pay for their education. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

band_descriptors.task_achievement: Both views are discussed and a clear opinion is given.
band_descriptors.coherence: Clear paragraphing with logical flow of ideas.
band_descriptors.lexical_resource: Wide range of vocabulary used accurately.
band_descriptors.grammar: Good control of grammar with complex sentences.

task1.title: Task 1: Letter/Email
task1.instructions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 120 words.
task1.prompt: You recently bought a product online but it arrived damaged. Write an email to the customer service department. In your email: - describe the product you ordered - explain the problem - say what you would like the company to do

band_descriptors.task_achievement: All bullet points are fully addressed. Tone is formal and polite.
band_descriptors.coherence: Information is logically sequenced with appropriate linking words.
band_descriptors.lexical_resource: Vocabulary is varied and appropriate for a complaint letter.
band_descriptors.grammar: Sentence structures are generally accurate with some variety.

task2.title: Task 2: Essay
task2.instructions: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
task2.prompt: Environmental problems are too big to be solved by individual action. They can only be solved by governments and large corporations. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

band_descriptors.task_achievement: A clear position is taken and supported throughout the essay.
band_descriptors.coherence: Ideas are well-organized with clear introduction, body, and conclusion.
band_descriptors.lexical_resource: Environmental vocabulary is used accurately and appropriately.
band_descriptors.grammar: A mix of simple and complex sentence structures is used effectively.

task1.title: Task 1: Letter/Email
task1.instructions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 120 words.
task1.prompt: You would like to apply for a part-time job at a local bookstore. Write a letter to the bookstore owner. In your letter: - explain why you are interested in the job - describe your relevant skills and experience - mention your availability

band_descriptors.task_achievement: All parts of the task are covered. The tone is professional.
band_descriptors.coherence: Paragraphs are clear and logically connected.

band_descriptors.grammar: Grammar is generally accurate with appropriate formal register.

task2.title: Task 2: Essay
task2.instructions: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
task2.prompt: Technology has made communication easier than ever before, but some people argue it has reduced face-to-face interaction. Do the benefits of technology in communication outweigh the drawbacks?

band_descriptors.task_achievement: Both benefits and drawbacks are considered with a clear overall position.
band_descriptors.coherence: Logical structure with smooth transitions between paragraphs.
band_descriptors.lexical_resource: Technology-related vocabulary is used with precision.
band_descriptors.grammar: Complex structures such as conditionals and relative clauses are used.

task1.title: Task 1: Letter/Email
task1.instructions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 120 words.
task1.prompt: Your neighbor's dog has been making a lot of noise late at night. Write a polite letter to your neighbor. In your letter: - explain the problem - describe how it affects you - suggest a possible solution

task2.title: Task 2: Essay
task2.instructions: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
task2.prompt: In many countries, the gap between the rich and the poor is growing. What are the causes of this trend, and what measures could governments take to reduce inequality?

band_descriptors.task_achievement: Causes and solutions are clearly identified and developed.
band_descriptors.coherence: Problem-solution structure is clear and well-organized.
band_descriptors.lexical_resource: Social and economic vocabulary is used accurately.
band_descriptors.grammar: Modal verbs and complex structures are used for suggestions and analysis.

task1.title: Task 1: Letter/Email
task1.instructions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 120 words.
task1.prompt: You recently attended a health and fitness workshop and found it very useful. Write an email to a friend who could not attend. In your email: - describe what the workshop was about - share the most useful thing you learned - suggest that your friend attend the next one

band_descriptors.task_achievement: All parts of the task are covered. Tone is friendly and informal.
band_descriptors.coherence: Ideas are organized clearly with natural transitions.
band_descriptors.lexical_resource: Health and fitness vocabulary is used appropriately.
band_descriptors.grammar: Grammar is accurate with some informal structures suitable for a friend.

task2.title: Task 2: Essay
task2.instructions: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
task2.prompt: Some people believe that a vegetarian diet is healthier than a diet that includes meat. Others think a balanced diet with meat is necessary for good health. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

band_descriptors.task_achievement: Both dietary perspectives are discussed with a clear personal opinion.
band_descriptors.lexical_resource: Health and nutrition vocabulary is used accurately.
band_descriptors.grammar: A range of grammatical structures is used with good control.
